briefdescription.para: Base interface for unified access tier abstraction (cache & storage).

detaileddescription.para: ThemisDB | File: access_tier_interface.h | Version: 1.0.0 Maturity: 🟡 ALPHA (Phase 1 API Definition) | Status: Frozen for v1.x Author: Copilot | Date: 2026-08-03

This header defines the abstract AccessTier contract that both cache and storage tiers implement. It enables the AccessCoordinator to manage promotion/demotion transitions uniformly without direct cache↔storage coupling.
